summary: Q1 2026 earnings: EPS $1.71 (+16.3% YoY) vs Zacks consensus $1.33; revenue $2.78B (+4.4% YoY) vs consensus $2.58B. Airfreight tonnage +5% YoY (tech customer strength). Ocean freight/services revenues declined to $598.9M on industry pressure. Operating income $294.8M (+11% YoY); operating margin ~10.6% vs ~10%. Stock surged 4.9% post-earnings, outperforming flat S&P 500 and industrial sector +0.9%.
